items.prompt: Your roommate drank your juice. Say it with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 室友喝了你的果汁。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 室友喝了你的果汁。用「被」说。

items.sub: 室友把我的果汁喝了。

sentence.traditional: 我的果汁被室友喝了。
sentence.simplified: 我的果汁被室友喝了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de guǒzhī bèi shìyǒu hē le.
sentence.english: My juice was drunk by my roommate.

repairs.note: 把 makes the doer the subject; here the juice is what something happened to.
對 marks the person you speak to or treat; it does not mark the doer.
給 marks a receiver, not who did the action.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我的果汁 + 被室友 + 喝了.
items.successNote: 被 puts the juice first because something happened to it.

items.prompt: Mom saw your brother playing games instead of doing homework. Say it with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 媽媽看見弟弟不寫功課，在玩遊戲。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 妈妈看见弟弟不写功课，在玩游戏。用「被」说。

items.sub: 媽媽看見弟弟不寫功課，在玩遊戲。

sentence.traditional: 弟弟不寫功課，在玩遊戲，被媽媽看見了。
sentence.simplified: 弟弟不写功课，在玩游戏，被妈妈看见了。
sentence.pinyin: Dìdi bù xiě gōngkè, zài wán yóuxì, bèi māma kànjiàn le.
sentence.english: My brother was seen by Mom playing games instead of doing his homework.

sentence.traditional: 弟弟在玩遊戲，不寫功課，被媽媽看見了。
sentence.simplified: 弟弟在玩游戏，不写功课，被妈妈看见了。
sentence.pinyin: Dìdi zài wán yóuxì, bù xiě gōngkè, bèi māma kànjiàn le.
sentence.english: My brother was playing games instead of doing his homework and was seen by Mom.

repairs.note: 把 would make Mom the object of 把, but here Mom is the one who saw him.

items.fallbackRepair: Start with 弟弟: 弟弟 + 不寫功課 + 在玩遊戲 + 被媽媽 + 看見了.

items.prompt: The puppy dirtied the shoes you just washed clean. Say it with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 小狗弄髒了我剛洗乾淨的鞋子。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 小狗弄脏了我刚洗干净的鞋子。用「被」说。

items.sub: 小狗弄髒了我剛洗乾淨的鞋子。

sentence.traditional: 我剛洗乾淨的鞋子被小狗弄髒了。
sentence.simplified: 我刚洗干净的鞋子被小狗弄脏了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ gāng xǐ gānjìng de xiézi bèi xiǎogǒu nòngzāng le.
sentence.english: The shoes I just washed clean were dirtied by the puppy.

repairs.note: 把 would make the shoes the doer and the puppy the object; here the puppy is the doer and the shoes are the patient.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我剛 + 洗乾淨的 + 鞋子 + 被小狗 + 弄髒了.

items.prompt: Your brother finished all the chocolate. Complete the sentence with 被 and 發現.

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了。用「被」和「發現」說。
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了。用「被」和「发现」说。

segments.traditional: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是
segments.simplified: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是

repairs.note: 弟弟 did not discover something; he was discovered, so the sentence needs 被.
Add 了 after the result: 被發現了.
Do not put 把 after 可是; the subject 弟弟 is the one something happened to.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 可是 + 被發現了.

result.traditional: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是被發現了。
result.simplified: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是被发现了。
result.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ qiǎokèlì dōu chī wán le, kěshì bèi fāxiàn le.
result.english: My brother finished all the chocolate, but he was caught.

items.successNote: 被 can stand alone when the doer is unknown.

items.prompt: The car is parked by the park. Complete the reply with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 先生的車停在公園旁邊。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 先生的车停在公园旁边。用「被」说。

items.sub: 先生：我找不到我的車，我要去找警察。

segments.traditional: 我找不到我的車，我要去找警察。
segments.simplified: 我找不到我的车，我要去找警察。

repairs.note: 沒 must come before 被: 沒被偷走.
Without 被, 沒偷走 sounds like the car did not steal something.
The car was not stolen; the sentence needs 沒被.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沒被偷走.

result.traditional: 你的車停在公園旁邊，沒被偷走啊！
result.simplified: 你的车停在公园旁边，没被偷走啊！
result.pinyin: Nǐ de chē tíng zài gōngyuán pángbiān, méi bèi tōuzǒu a!
result.english: Your car is parked by the park; it was not stolen!

items.successNote: Negation goes before 被.

items.prompt: The child says his friend played ball yesterday and then his head hurt. Complete both replies with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 孩子說朋友昨天打球，後來頭很疼。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 孩子说朋友昨天打球，后来头很疼。用「被」说。

segments.traditional: 那你去打球的時候得小心一點，不要
segments.simplified: 那你去打球的时候得小心一点，不要

repairs.note: 把球打到 would make the ball the thing being hit; here your friend is the one hit.
Without 被, 球 becomes the subject that hit someone.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 被球打到 in both blanks.

result.traditional: 我朋友昨天被球打到，頭很疼，所以今天沒去上課。那你去打球的時候得小心一點，不要被球打到。
result.simplified: 我朋友昨天被球打到，头很疼，所以今天没去上课。那你去打球的时候得小心一点，不要被球打到。
result.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou zuótiān bèi qiú dǎdào, tóu hěn téng, suǒyǐ jīntiān méi qù shàngkè. Nà nǐ qù dǎqiú de shíhou děi xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn, búyào bèi qiú dǎdào.
result.english: My friend was hit by a ball yesterday and his head hurt, so he did not go to class today. Be careful when you play ball; do not get hit by the ball.

items.successNote: The result 到 stays after the verb, and 被 marks who was hit.

items.prompt: Someone stole your money yesterday. Say it with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 昨天有人偷了你的錢。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 昨天有人偷了你的钱。用「被」说。

sentence.traditional: 我的錢昨天被偷了。
sentence.simplified: 我的钱昨天被偷了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de qián zuótiān bèi tōu le.
sentence.english: My money was stolen yesterday.

sentence.traditional: 昨天我的錢被偷了。
sentence.simplified: 昨天我的钱被偷了。
sentence.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ de qián bèi tōu le.
sentence.english: Yesterday my money was stolen.

repairs.note: 把 needs a doer; here no doer is named.
One 了 at the end is enough; do not add another.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我的錢 + 昨天 + 被 + 偷了.
items.successNote: The doer can be left out after 被.

items.prompt: The car was stolen by a thief. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說他的車被小偷偷了。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说他的车被小偷偷了。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: 從 marks a starting point; it does not fit between 被小偷 and 偷了.
對 does not fit between 被小偷 and 偷了.

items.takeOutNote: Right — 把 does not belong after 被; take it out.
items.hint: After 被 and the doer, the verb comes next; no extra word is needed.

result.traditional: 我的車被小偷偷了。
result.simplified: 我的车被小偷偷了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de chē bèi xiǎotōu tōu le.
result.english: My car was stolen by a thief.

items.successNote: 被 and 把 never share one passive sentence; use 被 + doer + verb.

items.prompt: Your brother did not finish the coffee. Say it with 被.

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟沒喝完那杯咖啡。用「被」說。
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟没喝完那杯咖啡。用「被」说。

sentence.traditional: 那杯咖啡沒被弟弟喝完。
sentence.simplified: 那杯咖啡没被弟弟喝完。
sentence.pinyin: Nà bēi kāfēi méi bèi dìdi hē wán.
sentence.english: That cup of coffee was not finished by my brother.

repairs.note: Put 沒 before 被: 沒被.
The result 完 is missing: 喝完.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 那杯咖啡 + 沒被 + 弟弟 + 喝完.
items.successNote: 沒 goes before 被, and the result 完 stays after the verb.

items.prompt: Your sister listened to music on the bus and then got home. Say it with V著V著.

promptZh.traditional: 妹妹在公車上聽音樂，然後就到家了。用「聽著聽著」說。
promptZh.simplified: 妹妹在公车上听音乐，然后就到家了。用「听着听着」说。

items.sub: 妹妹在公車上聽音樂，然後就到家了。

sentence.traditional: 妹妹在公車上聽音樂，聽著聽著就到家了。
sentence.simplified: 妹妹在公车上听音乐，听着听着就到家了。
sentence.pinyin: Mèimei zài gōngchē shàng tīng yīnyuè, tīngzhe tīngzhe jiù dào jiā le.
sentence.english: My sister listened to music on the bus, and while listening she got home.

sentence.traditional: 在公車上妹妹聽音樂，聽著聽著就到家了。
sentence.simplified: 在公车上妹妹听音乐，听着听着就到家了。
sentence.pinyin: Zài gōngchē shàng mèimei tīng yīnyuè, tīngzhe tīngzhe jiù dào jiā le.
sentence.english: On the bus, my sister listened to music, and while listening she got home.

repairs.note: V著V著 already links the two events; 然後 is not used here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 妹妹 + 在公車上 + 聽音樂 + 聽著聽著 + 就到家了.
items.successNote: V著V著 shows what was going on when the result came.

items.prompt: He walked to the library and then it rained. Say it with V著V著.

promptZh.traditional: 他走路去圖書館，後來下雨了。用「走著走著」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他走路去图书馆，后来下雨了。用「走着走着」说。

items.sub: 他走路去圖書館，後來下雨了。

sentence.traditional: 他走路去圖書館，走著走著就下雨了。
sentence.simplified: 他走路去图书馆，走着走着就下雨了。
sentence.pinyin: Tā zǒulù qù túshūguǎn, zǒuzhe zǒuzhe jiù xià yǔ le.
sentence.english: He walked to the library, and while walking it started to rain.

repairs.note: V著V著 already links the events; 後來 is not used here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 他 + 走路 + 去圖書館 + 走著走著 + 就下雨了.

items.prompt: Mom told the child a story, and the child fell asleep. Say the second part with V著V著.

promptZh.traditional: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，後來孩子睡著了。用「說著說著」說。
promptZh.simplified: 妈妈说故事给孩子听，后来孩子睡着了。用「说着说着」说。

repairs.note: V著V著 links the events; 後來 is not used here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 說著說著 + 孩子 + 就睡著了.
items.successNote: The first clause stays as it is; with two subjects, the second subject goes before 就.
items.sub: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，後來孩子睡著了。

sentence.traditional: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，說著說著孩子就睡著了。
sentence.simplified: 妈妈说故事给孩子听，说着说着孩子就睡着了。
sentence.pinyin: Māma shuō gùshì gěi háizi tīng, shuōzhe shuōzhe háizi jiù shuìzháo le.
sentence.english: Mom told the child a story, and while telling it the child fell asleep.

items.prompt: Dad watched TV and then fell asleep. Say it with V著V著.

promptZh.traditional: 爸爸看電視，後來睡著了。用「看著看著」說。
promptZh.simplified: 爸爸看电视，后来睡着了。用「看着看着」说。

sentence.traditional: 爸爸看電視，看著看著就睡著了。
sentence.simplified: 爸爸看电视，看着看着就睡着了。
sentence.pinyin: Bàba kàn diànshì, kànzhe kànzhe jiù shuìzháo le.
sentence.english: Dad watched TV, and while watching he fell asleep.

repairs.note: V著V著 already links the two events.
就睡著了 already ends in 了.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 爸爸 + 看電視 + 看著看著 + 就睡著了.

items.prompt: We chatted and then fell asleep. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說他們聊著聊著就睡著了。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说他们聊着聊着就睡着了。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: 睡覺 is the general verb; the sentence needs the result 睡著了.
著 belongs after 睡: 睡著了.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take the word out; swap the last two characters: 睡著了.
items.hint: The result 著 comes right after the verb 睡.

result.traditional: 我們聊著聊著就睡著了。
result.simplified: 我们聊着聊着就睡着了。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen liáozhe liáozhe jiù shuìzháo le.
result.english: We chatted and chatted, and then fell asleep.

items.successNote: 睡著了 means fell asleep; 著 is the result, not a separate word.

items.prompt: Your friend's Chinese characters look bad. Answer with 只要……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 朋友的中文字寫得不好看。用「只要……就……」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友的中文字写得不好看。用「只要……就……」回答。

items.sub: A：我的中文字寫得不好看，怎麼辦？（多練習）

sentence.traditional: 沒關係，只要多練習就好了。
sentence.simplified: 没关系，只要多练习就好了。
sentence.pinyin: Méi guānxi, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù hǎo le.
sentence.english: It's all right; as long as you practice more, it will be fine.

repairs.note: 只要 pairs with 就, not 才.
一定 does not connect the condition to the result here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沒關係 + 只要 + 多練習 + 就好了.
items.successNote: 只要 gives the easy condition; 就 gives the result.

items.prompt: A friend's body is not healthy. Answer with 只要……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 朋友的身體不健康。用「只要……就……」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友的身体不健康。用「只要……就……」回答。

items.sub: A：應該怎麼做，我的身體才會比較健康？（少吃甜點／多運動）

sentence.traditional: 只要你少吃甜點、多運動，就會比較健康。
sentence.simplified: 只要你少吃甜点、多运动，就会比较健康。
sentence.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō yùndòng, jiù huì bǐjiào jiànkāng.
sentence.english: As long as you eat fewer sweets and exercise more, you will be healthier.

sentence.traditional: 只要你多運動、少吃甜點，就會比較健康。
sentence.simplified: 只要你多运动、少吃甜点，就会比较健康。
sentence.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, jiù huì bǐjiào jiànkāng.
sentence.english: As long as you exercise more and eat fewer sweets, you will be healthier.

repairs.note: The result after 只要 uses 就.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 只要你 + 少吃甜點 + 多運動 + 就會 + 比較健康.
items.successNote: One 只要 can cover two conditions.

items.prompt: The child wants to lie on the lawn in the park. Answer as the mother with 只要……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 孩子想在公園的草地上躺。用「只要……就……」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 孩子想在公园的草地上躺。用「只要……就……」回答。

items.sub: 孩子：我可以躺在公園的草地上嗎？（垃圾／蟲子）

sentence.traditional: 只要沒有垃圾、沒有蟲子，就可以躺。
sentence.simplified: 只要没有垃圾、没有虫子，就可以躺。
sentence.pinyin: Zhǐyào méiyǒu lèsè, méiyǒu chóngzi, jiù kěyǐ tǎng.
sentence.english: As long as there is no trash and no bugs, you can lie there.

sentence.traditional: 只要沒有蟲子、沒有垃圾，就可以躺。
sentence.simplified: 只要没有虫子、没有垃圾，就可以躺。
sentence.pinyin: Zhǐyào méiyǒu chóngzi, méiyǒu lèsè, jiù kěyǐ tǎng.
sentence.english: As long as there are no bugs and no trash, you can lie there.

repairs.note: 但是 turns against the condition; the sentence gives an easy permission.
The result after 只要 uses 就.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 只要 + 沒有垃圾 + 沒有蟲子 + 就可以躺.

items.prompt: It may rain tomorrow, and we want to go camping. Say it with 只要……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 明天可能下雨。我們想去露營。用「只要……就……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 明天可能下雨。我们想去露营。用「只要……就……」说。

sentence.traditional: 只要明天不下雨，我們就去露營。
sentence.simplified: 只要明天不下雨，我们就去露营。
sentence.pinyin: Zhǐyào míngtiān bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng.
sentence.english: As long as it does not rain tomorrow, we will go camping.

sentence.traditional: 明天只要不下雨，我們就去露營。
sentence.simplified: 明天只要不下雨，我们就去露营。
sentence.pinyin: Míngtiān zhǐyào bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng.
sentence.english: As long as it does not rain tomorrow, we will go camping.

repairs.note: 只要 pairs with 就.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 只要 + 明天 + 不下雨 + 我們 + 就去露營.
items.successNote: The condition comes after 只要; the result comes after 就.

items.prompt: My friend wants to say that as long as you practice more, you can speak Chinese well. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說只要多練習就可以把中文說好。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说只要多练习就可以把中文说好。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: 才 marks a hard or late result; 只要 pairs with 就.
The subject 你 comes before 就: 你就.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; the subject 你 goes before 就.
items.hint: The subject 你 comes before 就 in the result.

result.traditional: 只要多練習，你就可以把中文說好。
result.simplified: 只要多练习，你就可以把中文说好。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyào duō liànxí, nǐ jiù kěyǐ bǎ Zhōngwén shuō hǎo.
result.english: As long as you practice more, you can speak Chinese well.

items.successNote: In the result, the subject comes before 就.

items.prompt: A friend asks what you do at home after work. Answer with 有時候……有時候…….

promptZh.traditional: 朋友問你每天下班以後在家做什麼。用「有時候……有時候……」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友问你每天下班以后在家做什么。用「有时候……有时候……」回答。

items.sub: A：你每天下班以後，都在家做什麼？

sentence.traditional: 我有時候看電視，有時候看書。
sentence.simplified: 我有时候看电视，有时候看书。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou kàn diànshì, yǒu shíhou kàn shū.
sentence.english: Sometimes I watch TV, and sometimes I read.

sentence.traditional: 我有時候看書，有時候看電視。
sentence.simplified: 我有时候看书，有时候看电视。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou kàn shū, yǒu shíhou kàn diànshì.
sentence.english: Sometimes I read, and sometimes I watch TV.

sentence.traditional: 有時候我看電視，有時候看書。
sentence.simplified: 有时候我看电视，有时候看书。
sentence.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou wǒ kàn diànshì, yǒu shíhou kàn shū.
sentence.english: Sometimes I watch TV, and sometimes I read.

sentence.traditional: 有時候我看書，有時候看電視。
sentence.simplified: 有时候我看书，有时候看电视。
sentence.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou wǒ kàn shū, yǒu shíhou kàn diànshì.
sentence.english: Sometimes I read, and sometimes I watch TV.

repairs.note: 才 means only then; the two actions alternate, so use 有時候 twice.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我 + 有時候 + 看電視 + 有時候 + 看書.
items.successNote: 有時候…有時候… shows both happen at different times.

items.prompt: A friend asks what color clothes your sister likes. Answer with 有時候……有時候…….

segments.simplified: 山本良介害羞的时候，脸就

repairs.note: 紅了 just says red; 起來 shows the face started to get red.
Add 來: 紅起來了.
很紅 describes a state; 起來 shows the change.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 臉就紅起來了.

items.successNote: V起來了 shows an action starting.

items.prompt: The morning weather was nice, but it started to rain in the afternoon. Say it with 起來.

promptZh.traditional: 早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午開始下雨了。用「起來」說。

The sentence needs 起來了 to show the start.
下起雨 comes before 來了: 下起雨來了.
來了 closes the phrase after 雨.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 下起雨來了.

result.traditional: 是啊！早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午就下起雨來了。

items.prompt: There are many people buying movie tickets. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 買電影票的人很多。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 买电影票的人很多。用「还好……要不然……」说。

items.sub: A：你看，今天排隊買電影票的人真多！

repairs.note: Coming late would make it harder to buy tickets.
The first line says there are many people, so 人不多 contradicts it.
來得早 is the full phrase; 早 alone does not fit after 我們.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好我們 + 來得早.

result.traditional: 是啊！還好我們來得早，要不然一定買不到。
result.simplified: 是啊！还好我们来得早，要不然一定买不到。
result.pinyin: Shì a! Háihǎo wǒmen lái de zǎo, yàobùrán yídìng mǎi bú dào.
result.english: Right! Fortunately we came early; otherwise we definitely could not buy tickets.

items.successNote: 還好 names the good thing; 要不然 names the bad result without it.

items.prompt: This community has security staff. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 這個社區有安全人員。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这个社区有安全人员。用「还好……要不然……」说。

items.sub: A：這個社區安全嗎？

segments.traditional: 還好有安全人員，要不然一定很
segments.simplified: 还好有安全人员，要不然一定很

repairs.note: 要不然 introduces the bad result; it is not safe.
了 marks a change; the sentence describes a state.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 要不然一定很不安全.

result.traditional: 還好有安全人員，要不然一定很不安全。
result.simplified: 还好有安全人员，要不然一定很不安全。
result.pinyin: Háihǎo yǒu ānquán rényuán, yàobùrán yídìng hěn bù ānquán.
result.english: Fortunately there are security staff; otherwise it would definitely be unsafe.

items.successNote: 還好 gives the good situation; 要不然 gives the bad alternative.

items.prompt: The scholarship is 20,000 a month and the rent is 5,000 a month. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 獎學金一個月兩萬塊，房租一個月五千塊。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 奖学金一个月两万块，房租一个月五千块。用「还好……要不然……」说。

items.sub: A：你的獎學金一個月兩萬塊，夠嗎？

repairs.note: 很貴 would make 還好 wrong: cheap rent is the good thing.
要不然 introduces the bad result, so it is not enough.
不夠了 is the bad result; it goes after 要不然就, not after 房租.
不貴 describes the rent; it goes after 房租, before 要不然.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好房租不貴，要不然就不夠了.

result.traditional: 還好房租不貴，要不然就不夠了。
result.simplified: 还好房租不贵，要不然就不够了。
result.pinyin: Háihǎo fángzū bú guì, yàobùrán jiù bú gòu le.
result.english: Fortunately the rent is not expensive; otherwise it would not be enough.

items.successNote: 還好 + good fact, 要不然 + the bad result.

items.prompt: You brought your phone, so you can find the way. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 你帶了手機，所以找得到路。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你带了手机，所以找得到路。用「还好……要不然……」说。

sentence.traditional: 還好帶了手機，要不然就找不到路了。
sentence.simplified: 还好带了手机，要不然就找不到路了。
sentence.pinyin: Háihǎo dài le shǒujī, yàobùrán jiù zhǎo bú dào lù le.
sentence.english: Fortunately I brought my phone; otherwise I could not find the way.

repairs.note: 但是 only contrasts; this sentence shows relief about what did not happen.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好 + 帶了手機 + 要不然 + 就找不到 + 路了.

items.prompt: There is a bus, so going up the hill is not hard. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

sentence.traditional: 還好有巴士，要不然走路上山很辛苦。

B2L05-G07-P131.title: Practice: 每 + Nu + M₁（+就）+ V + Nu + M₂

items.prompt: Mr. Zhang plays tennis once a week. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 張先生一個禮拜打一次網球。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 张先生一个礼拜打一次网球。用「每」说。

items.sub: 張先生一個禮拜打一次網球。

sentence.traditional: 張先生每個禮拜打一次網球。
sentence.simplified: 张先生每个礼拜打一次网球。
sentence.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng měi ge lǐbài dǎ yí cì wǎngqiú.
sentence.english: Mr. Zhang plays tennis once every week.

sentence.traditional: 每個禮拜張先生打一次網球。
sentence.simplified: 每个礼拜张先生打一次网球。
sentence.pinyin: Měi ge lǐbài Zhāng xiānsheng dǎ yí cì wǎngqiú.
sentence.english: Every week, Mr. Zhang plays tennis once.

repairs.note: 每天 means every day; he plays once a week.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 張先生 + 每個禮拜 + 打 + 一次 + 網球.
items.successNote: 每 + time + V + frequency.

items.prompt: His bathroom is clean because he cleans it on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為星期二、四、六都要打掃。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为星期二、四、六都要打扫。用「每」说。

items.sub: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為星期二、四、六都要打掃。

segments.traditional: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為
segments.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为

repairs.note: 星期二、四、六 is every two days, not every day.
兩天 needs 每 before it: 每兩天.
一次 is the frequency; it goes after the verb 打掃.
每兩天 is the frequency period; it goes before 就要打掃.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 因為每兩天就要打掃一次.

result.traditional: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為每兩天就要打掃一次。
result.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为每两天就要打扫一次。
result.pinyin: Tā jiā de yùshì hěn gānjìng, yīnwèi měi liǎng tiān jiù yào dǎsǎo yí cì.
result.english: His bathroom is very clean because it is cleaned once every two days.

items.successNote: 每 + number + measure word gives the regular frequency.

items.prompt: The doctor says to rest after reading for thirty minutes. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 醫生說，看三十分鐘的書，就應該休息一下。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 医生说，看三十分钟的书，就应该休息一下。用「每」说。

items.sub: 醫生說，看三十分鐘的書，就應該休息一下。

sentence.traditional: 醫生說，每三十分鐘休息一次。
sentence.simplified: 医生说，每三十分钟休息一次。
sentence.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, měi sānshí fēnzhōng xiūxi yí cì.
sentence.english: The doctor says to rest once every thirty minutes.

repairs.note: The doctor says every thirty minutes, not every day.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 醫生說 + 每 + 三十分鐘 + 休息 + 一次.

items.prompt: Place 就 where it belongs.

promptZh.traditional: 把「就」放好。
promptZh.simplified: 把「就」放好。

repairs.note: 就 comes before the verb 回, not after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 就 before 回: 每半年就回一次日本.

result.traditional: 他每半年就回一次日本。
result.simplified: 他每半年就回一次日本。
result.pinyin: Tā měi bàn nián jiù huí yí cì Rìběn.
result.english: He goes back to Japan once every half year.

items.successNote: 就 goes before the verb; it emphasizes the regular frequency.

items.prompt: He goes back to Japan once a month. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 他一個月回一次日本。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他一个月回一次日本。用「每」说。

sentence.traditional: 他每個月回一次日本。
sentence.simplified: 他每个月回一次日本。
sentence.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè huí yí cì Rìběn.
sentence.english: He goes back to Japan once every month.

sentence.traditional: 每個月他回一次日本。
sentence.simplified: 每个月他回一次日本。
sentence.pinyin: Měi ge yuè tā huí yí cì Rìběn.
sentence.english: Every month, he goes back to Japan once.

repairs.note: 每天 means every day; he goes once a month.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 他 + 每個月 + 回 + 一次 + 日本.

items.prompt: My friend eats steak once every three days. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說他每三天吃一次牛排。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说他每三天吃一次牛排。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: 牛排 is what he eats; 一次 comes before it.
一次 belongs before 牛排, not after it.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; move 一次 before 牛排.
items.hint: The frequency 一次 comes before the food.

result.traditional: 我朋友每三天就吃一次牛排。
result.simplified: 我朋友每三天就吃一次牛排。
result.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou měi sān tiān jiù chī yí cì niúpái.
result.english: My friend eats steak once every three days.

items.successNote: 每 + time + 就 + V + frequency + object.

items.prompt: At Mid-Autumn Festival, what is a Taiwanese mooncake as round as?

promptZh.traditional: 中秋節的時候，台灣的月餅像什麼一樣圓？
promptZh.simplified: 中秋节的时候，台湾的月饼像什么一样圆？

items.sub: 台灣的月餅像____一樣圓。

repairs.note: The Mid-Autumn mooncake is compared with the moon, not the sun.
Stars are not round like mooncakes.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像月亮一樣圓.

result.traditional: 台灣的月餅像月亮一樣圓。
result.simplified: 台湾的月饼像月亮一样圆。
result.pinyin: Táiwān de yuèbǐng xiàng yuèliàng yíyàng yuán.
result.english: Taiwanese mooncakes are as round as the moon.

items.successNote: 像 + B + 一樣 + Vs.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 用「像……一樣」把句子說好。
promptZh.simplified: 用「像……一样」把句子说好。

items.sub: 這種飲料的味道不錯，像____。

segments.traditional: 這種飲料的味道不錯，像
segments.simplified: 这种饮料的味道不错，像

repairs.note: Put 一樣 after the noun: 果汁一樣.
The comparison uses 一樣, not 很.
很 cannot come before 果汁 here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像果汁一樣.

result.traditional: 這種飲料的味道不錯，像果汁一樣。
result.simplified: 这种饮料的味道不错，像果汁一样。
result.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào de wèidào búcuò, xiàng guǒzhī yíyàng.
result.english: This drink tastes good; it is like juice.

items.successNote: 像 + B + 一樣 completes the comparison.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 用「像……一樣」把句子說好。
promptZh.simplified: 用「像……一样」把句子说好。

items.sub: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，像____。

segments.traditional: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，像
segments.simplified: 林小姐说话的声音很温柔，像

repairs.note: 一樣 comes after 媽媽.
Use 一樣, not 很, to finish the comparison.
很 does not fit before 媽媽.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像媽媽一樣.

result.traditional: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，像媽媽一樣。
result.simplified: 林小姐说话的声音很温柔，像妈妈一样。
result.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn wēnróu, xiàng māma yíyàng.
result.english: Ms. Lin's voice is very gentle, like Mom's.

items.successNote: The person compared with comes after 像; 一樣 closes the phrase.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 用「像……一樣」把句子說好。
promptZh.simplified: 用「像……一样」把句子说好。

items.sub: 我的同學覺得露營像野餐____。

segments.traditional: 我的同學覺得露營像野餐
segments.simplified: 我的同学觉得露营像野餐

repairs.note: Put 一樣 before the adjective: 一樣好玩.
The comparison needs 一樣 before 好玩.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像野餐一樣好玩.

result.traditional: 我的同學覺得露營像野餐一樣好玩。
result.simplified: 我的同学觉得露营像野餐一样好玩。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngxué juéde lùyíng xiàng yěcān yíyàng hǎowán.
result.english: My classmate thinks camping is as fun as a picnic.

items.successNote: The shared quality comes after 一樣.

items.prompt: This drink is like juice, and the juice is also sweet. Say it with 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 這杯飲料像果汁，果汁也很甜。用「像……一樣」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这杯饮料像果汁，果汁也很甜。用「像……一样」说。

sentence.traditional: 這杯飲料像果汁一樣甜。
sentence.simplified: 这杯饮料像果汁一样甜。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè bēi yǐnliào xiàng guǒzhī yíyàng tián.
sentence.english: This drink is as sweet as juice.

repairs.note: 一樣 already links the two; do not add 很 before 甜.
This is a description, not a change; 了 is not needed.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 這杯飲料 + 像果汁 + 一樣 + 甜.

items.prompt: The child's face is as red as an apple. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: The comparison needs 一樣 before 紅, not 很.
Red alone does not complete 像…一樣.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; the comparison needs 一樣紅.
items.hint: The shared quality follows 一樣.

result.traditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅。
result.simplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红。
result.pinyin: Nàge háizi de liǎn xiàng píngguǒ yíyàng hóng.
result.english: That child's face is as red as an apple.

items.successNote: 像 + B + 一樣 + Vs puts the quality last.

items.prompt: Watching TV and listening to music both feel relaxing to you. Say it with 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 你覺得看電視和聽音樂都很輕鬆。用「像……一樣」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你觉得看电视和听音乐都很轻松。用「像……一样」说。

sentence.traditional: 我覺得看電視像聽音樂一樣輕鬆。
sentence.simplified: 我觉得看电视像听音乐一样轻松。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ juéde kàn diànshì xiàng tīng yīnyuè yíyàng qīngsōng.
sentence.english: I think watching TV is as relaxing as listening to music.

sentence.traditional: 看電視我覺得像聽音樂一樣輕鬆。
sentence.simplified: 看电视我觉得像听音乐一样轻松。
sentence.pinyin: Kàn diànshì wǒ juéde xiàng tīng yīnyuè yíyàng qīngsōng.
sentence.english: Watching TV, I feel as relaxed as listening to music.

repairs.note: 一樣 already marks the comparison; 很 is not used before 輕鬆 here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我覺得 + 看電視 + 像聽音樂 + 一樣 + 輕鬆.
items.successNote: 像…一樣 can compare two actions, not just two things.
